entities.summary: Fabio Albergati was an Italian diplomat, writer, political philosopher, and moralist. Albergati lived during the aftermath of the Protestant Reformation and wrote against the background of religious and ideological conflict. He was a staunch Catholic throughout his life and was highly critical of Jean Bodin and Niccolò Machiavelli.
